ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) base layer with localized clusters of high-intensity (white) pixels forming distinct patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white circular ring clusters distributed across both lobes; a significant contiguous white field containing vertical dark linear stripes is located on the upper interior region of the right lobe; white pigmentation highlights the distal tips and portions of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the fluke center with a sharp pixel vertex; the notch extends significantly into the fluke body relative to the total vertical pixel height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations; pixel peaks and valleys create a jagged linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Marked upward convex sweep of the trailing edges, ending in sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of white circular pixel clusters (5-20 pixel diameters) representing old barnacle attachment sites, densely populated across the left lobe and inner-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary detection of a series of approximately 10-12 parallel vertical white lines (rake marks) on the upper right lobe; secondary detection of scattered, non-parallel linear white streaks on both lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical rake mark scarring on the right lobe; pervasive circular scarring across the ventral surface; irregular trailing edge indicative of high-frequency wear or minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of a high-intensity white 'comb' pattern on the right lobe and dense white circular clusters on the left lobe provides a highly unique spatial pixel signature.
